desc: Implement Fenwick tree class with methods: __init__(n), update(i, val) for point max (i 1-indexed), query(i) for prefix max.
Read N, Q, array A (1-indexed), and queries into list of (R, X, idx).
Coordinate-compress A values plus all X_i into sorted unique list `vals`. Map each A[i] to comp[i] via bisect_left; map each X_i to Xc = bisect_right(vals, X_i) (note: prefix query uses Xc).
Compute dp[i] = 1 + temp_BIT.query(comp[i]-1) using a temporary BIT; then temp_BIT.update(comp[i], dp[i]).

Sort queries by R ascending. Initialize answer BIT empty (size = len(vals)+2). Sweep i from 1 to N: answer_BIT.update(comp[i], dp[i]); for each query with R == i (or use pointer while queries[sorted_pos].R == i), answer = answer_BIT.query(Xc); store in ans[original_idx].
Output answers in original order, one per line.
Edge cases: X smaller than all A values in prefix returns 0 (Xc == 0). X larger than all values returns answer_BIT.query(len(vals)). Ensure BIT handles index 0 correctly (return 0).
